title: Abidda masaraa of tuulummaa keessa jiru
intro: Dallaa guddaa masaraa mootummaa addunyaa durii isa humna guddaa qabu duuba namni onneen isaa iccitii labsiin mootii kamiyyuu callisuu hin dandeenye qabate jiraata ture. Naannoo hundumaa waaqolii sobaaf osoo jilbeenfatu lubbuun kun amantii callisaa keessa ishee gubaa turte. Bulchaan biyya sanaa waaqa ta’uu isaanii amana ture, ta’us namni dhuunfaa kun jajjabina irra dhugaa, nageenya caalaa of kennuu filate. Har’a hojiin kee lubbuun ija jabinaan kun eenyu akka turte, seenaan ishee fakkeenya amantii hin raafamne keessaa isa cimaa ta’ee hafe baruudha.
clues: Bakka qabeenya guddaa fi guddina gita hin qabne, kan bulchaan biyyattii hundumaa irratti aangoo guutuu qabu keessa jiraadha ture.
Namoonni naannoo koo jiran waaqolii sobaaf utuu jilbeenfatan, ani immoo ifa amantii callisaa garaa koo keessaa qabadheen ture.
Mucaa karaa hin baratamneen natti fidame argadhee guddifadhe - dhalootaan osoo hin taane, bishaan laga guddaa keessaa.
Jannata keessatti mana isaatti dhihoo ta’ee fi irree na marsee jiru irraa fayyina jedheen Gooftaa kiyya kadhadhe.
Mucaan ani guddise bulchaa hiree koo to’atu sana mormuuf guddate, yeroon doorsifamullee amantii koo irratti jabeesseen dhaabadhe.
Ani nama Qur'aana keessatti akka fakkeenya amantiitti maqaan isaa kabajame, masaraa Fara'oon mataa isaa keessa jiraadhe.

arabic: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًۭا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًۭا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And Allāh presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people." (66:11)
